_legacyDomains: Former domains, kept after a domain switch. On switch day the old domain moves here (e.g. ["saathum.com"]). The api. and media. hosts of every legacy domain stay attached to the Worker/storage FOREVER — installed app builds, links in old emails and image URLs stored in the database all point at them. A legacy website may redirect to the current domain after the new site is verified. Service aliases stay attached. Leave [] until a switch happens.
